input_definition: The same applied per-pod thrust in newtons and applied pod azimuth in radians are recorded from bcod-sim and replayed in Gazebo.
pass_rule: Every metric must pass in every case.
scope: Kinematic thrust-vectoring, allocation, frame conversion and mapped actuator response only.
interaction_exclusion: Neither implementation models pod-hull interaction, pod-pod interaction, or angle-dependent thrust degradation. Agreement cannot validate those mechanisms.
